system.description:
Partially hides character from specific senses or detection techniques in a 3m area.

  • Level 1: 1 sense/technique blocked
  • Level 2: 2 senses/techniques blocked
  • Level 3: 3 senses/techniques blocked
  • Level 4: 4 senses/techniques blocked
  • Level 5: 5 senses/techniques blocked
  • Level 6: 6 senses/techniques blocked
